name: Cable GMSL, FAKRA-Z, 1x F/F

sources.title: Basler Cable GMSL, FAKRA-Z, 1x F/F (Basler product documentation)
sources.covers: article numbers and lengths, connectors, cable diameter, shielding, jacket, minimum bend radius fixed and moving, bending cycles, impedance, frequency range, insertion loss, voltage and current, operating temperature

note: A 50 ohm coaxial GMSL camera cable with a FAKRA-Z female connector at each end (colour water blue, RAL 5021), double-braided tinned copper shield, black polyurethane jacket. Stated: cable diameter "3.45 mm max." (diameter_mm is that maximum); minimum bend radius "13.8 mm" fixed and "34.5 mm" moving; "5 million" bending cycles (the test radius and stroke are not stated); frequency range DC 0-6 GHz; insertion loss -1.15 dB/m nominal at 3 GHz and -1.7 dB/m at 6 GHz; 60 V and 3 A maximum; operating temperature -40 to 80 C fixed, -5 to 60 C moving. Lengths: 3 m (2200002798), 5 m (2200002799), 10 m (2200002800), 15 m (2200002801). The page says "The cable is suitable for ace 2 GMSL cameras" and lists it as suitable for drag chain and robotics applications; it does not name a GMSL generation, so type is 'gmsl'.
